content.title: Camp Sonshine | Summer Day Camps | Montgomery County, Maryland
content.text: Life-Changing Summer Camp Programs Choose Your Experience A safe and convenient place where kids have fun, grow, and make memories that last a lifetime. “Our family loves this camp. It’s great value for the price. The counselors are high-energy, positive, and very caring.” -Cari M. “We absolutely LOVE this camp. The camp’s bus service makes it very easy for me to drop them off and pick them up each day.” -Dean P. “Camp provides a variety of activities on-site and off-site, and each year my kids enjoy experiencing new activities that challenge them.” -Camp Parent We Know How Important Choosing the Right Summer Camp Most parents get stressed when their kids are out of school for the summer. We have an amazing camp with fun activities and quality counselors. Kids love it and parents know they made the right choice. We believe that every parent should have a fun, safe and convenient place for their kids in the summer. We understand how difficult it can be to find a place like that. That’s why for more than 40 years we’ve helped parents give their kids an amazing camp experience they’ll never forget. Want to Schedule a Tour? We’d love to show you around! Call our office or fill out our form below to schedule a tour today! “The camp counselors are positive, mature, and professional. The days are packed with fun and creative activities.” – Ed S. Are Your Kids Tired of Boring Summers? Here’s how to make a change: Register Online Register online for the programs and extended summer dates that work for your schedule. Choose Your Options Select the convenience options (extended care and bus transportation) that your family needs. GIVE YOUR KIDS THE BEST SUMMER EVER Your child will experience a fun and safe place to make new friends and enjoy fun activities that will have them wanting more.
